title: Re:Zero kara Hajimeru Kyuukei Jikan (Break Time) 3rd Season
justification: AniList 182417 has 16 ONA episodes (2024-10-03 to 2025-03-26; 'Re:Zero kara Hajimeru Break Time 3rd Season'). AniDB 17947 (PARENT per AniList 163134) S1-S16 are 'Re:Zero - Starting Break Time from Zero #1..#16' (2024-10-03 to 2025-03-27, one day later than AniList at the end). TVDB 305089 season 0 episodes 55-70 are 'Re:Zero - Starting Break Time from Zero: ...' with the matching story titles in the same order (Night Tales of the Sleeping Oni, Emilia Party Struggles 1, CHOMP of LOVE and PASSION, Doki-Doki Royal Selection Social Gathering 1, Great Waterfalls Followers 1-2, Doki-Doki 2-3, Emilia Party Struggles 2, Pre-Theater Malice, Scarlet Romantic Tales, Emilia Party Struggles 3-7), dated 2024-10-02 to 2025-03-26, each one day before AniDB. S17-S18 (theater manners, pre-broadcast stage) are other items. The repeated titles ('Emilia Party Struggles' x7) are ordered by position, as the overlay entry's justification records.
